entities.name: Thran Civil War
entities.description: A 100-year conflict between Thran city-state factions that ended with the banishment of the eugenicists.

entities.name: Artificers
entities.description: Thran faction championed by the elite imperialists who improved the Thran through powerstone artifacts.

entities.name: Eugenicists
entities.description: Thran faction championed by the republican rabble who studied biology to improve Thran health.

entities.name: Elder Council
entities.description: Thran ruling body that exiled the eugenicist champions and later recalled Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Thirty-year-old eugenicist banished to Jamuraa, later recalled to cure Glacian.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Desert land to which the eugenicists were banished.

entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: Most prominent artificer, who fell sick with powerstone induced phthisis.

events.summary: The imperialists defeat the republicans, and the eugenicist champions are scapegoated and exiled.
events.quote: the eugenicist champions were scapegoated and exiled by the Elder Council

events.summary: Yawgmoth and 200 followers are banished to the deserts of Jamuraa, ending the war.
events.quote: and 200 of his followers, were among those who were banished to the deserts of

events.summary: Glacian falls ill and the Elder Council recalls Yawgmoth to cure him, returning the eugenicists to power.
events.quote: The Elder Council voted to recall Yawgmoth to Halcyon to find a cure for Glacian
